description: Submit a synthetic test CSR through the compiler's own (just-promoted) ICA and verify the signed chain against the root CA. Runs on the compiler; proves it signs certificates without primary involvement. On a verification failure, reverts the compiler's bootstrap.cfg back to CA-proxy mode before reporting invalid. Used by peadm::promote_compiler_to_ica.

primary_host.description: Certname/FQDN of the PE primary, used to fetch the root CA certificate to verify the test chain against.
